remarks: Quality ESSEX HOME is under construction with an expected completion in Spring 2027! This 'Devonshire' home plan, located in the highly popular Eagle Heights community, features 3,675 sq. ft. of luxury living space with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, soaring 9' ceilings on the 1st floor and basement. A show-stopping exterior with a covered front porch features an impressive 8’ tall, custom, decorative front door with Essex “Signature Trim," light-welcoming sidelight windows, rich stone accents, and iconic black windows that are accented by stunning black garage overhead doors. A welcoming 2-story foyer provides access to the den and dining room and includes an optimal front hall storage closet.  8' tall doors, and wide-plank laminate plank flooring throughout the first floor provide an airy open feel. A private den with 8' tall French doors and a formal dining room accented with rich crown molding and shadow boxes. Spacious kitchen with professional built-in appliances, oversized island, dry bar, and a spacious walk-in pantry! A 3-car garage offers additional indoor parking and leads to a mudroom with built-in bench/cubbies/coat rack. The elegant Primary Bedroom suite features a double-door entry, a box ceiling with accent lighting, rich crown molding, and the walk-in closet of your dreams, with a cathedral ceiling, a convenient linen closet, and the ability to fully customize your closet shelving with our design team. A "spa-worthy" Primary Bathroom features a programmable heated flooring system, a box ceiling, a stunning free-standing tub, dual vanities with quartz countertops, and a frameless glass-enclosed tile shower with a custom Kohler dual showerhead and rain shower system, a tile bench seat, and a private Commode Room. Three spacious secondary bedrooms, each with its own bathroom entrance. A large activity room provides an inviting approach on the 2nd floor and access to the 2nd-floor laundry. Exterior and interior images and the virtual tour are of a similar home. Be the first to call this incredible house your home!
